basic_data.description:
Enhance your Dying Light 2 experience. Get the most out of the vast open world of Dying Light 2: Stay Human with this bundle of Dying Light 2 DLC! In this giant collection of extras (main game not included) you’ll find tons of useful items to upgrade your journey through Villedor and beyond. The Welcome Offer: Essential Starter Kit includes a resource bundle, an XP booster, and a deadly serrated kukri! The G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle has everything you need to clean up the city while avoiding contamination! And if you’re looking for some light reading material, the Goodies Pack–Arts includes a digital artbook for the game, a digital comic, and some ready-to-print wallpapers! Enhance your experience parkouring through the wilds and wastelands of Dying Light 2 with this DLC collection, pay what you want, and support the Make-A-Wish Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before April 21st, 2027.

Pay €6.25 or more. Normally, the total cost for the games in this bundle is as much as US$65. Here at Humble Bundle, you choose the price and increase your contribution to upgrade your bundle! This bundle has a minimum €6.25 purchase. Pay €6.25 or more to access Steam keys.

Redeem on Steam. All of the games in this bundle are available on Steam for Windows. Please review the system requirements here prior to purchasing.

Support charity. Choose where the money goes - between the developer and to support Make-A-Wish Foundation of America. If you like what we do, you can leave us a Humble Tip too!

make_a_wish.description_text:
Donations to support Make-A-Wish are made to  PayPal Giving Fund, subject to its policies.

Make-A-Wish® creates life-changing wishes for children with critical illnesses. We seek to bring every eligible child's wish to life because a wish is an integral part of a child's treatment journey. Research shows children who have wishes granted can build the physical and emotional strength they need to fight their illness. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, Make-A-Wish is the world’s leading children’s wish-granting organization, serving children in more than 50 countries worldwide. Together, generous donors, supporters, staff and more than 40,000 volunteers, grant a wish every 17 minutes, on average, somewhere in the world. Since 1980, Make-A-Wish has granted nearly 450,000 wishes to children; more than 30,000 last year alone. For more information about Make-A-Wish International, visit worldwish.org and for more information about Make-A-Wish America, visit wish.org.

ppgf_info.description: Make-A-Wish grants the wishes of children with life-threatening medical conditions to enrich the human experience with hope, strength and joy. Make-A-Wish is the world's largest wish-granting organization, serving children in nearly 50 countries on five continents. With the help of generous donors and more than 40,000 volunteers worldwide, Make-A-Wish grants a wish somewhere in the world every 17 minutes on average. Since 1980, it has granted more than 500,000 wishes to children around the world.

There’s even more fun to be had in this fantastic bundle of fan-favorite games, so grab them now at the price of your choosing and support Child’s Play with your purchase!

dyinglight2-chickenbundle.description_text:
Become a one-of-a-kind angry bird.
It’s time to shake a tail feather and establish a new pecking order in The City. As a chicken that fears no one, you have to break some bad eggs to make an omelet. Use a claw that can cut and scratch your enemies until they become a chicken-hearted mess. And if someone dares to doubt your ability to fly, prove them wrong by taking it to the skies with a featherweight paraglider.

The bundle contains:
  • Rooster Suit — wear this outfit, and all of your enemies will chicken out when facing you!
  • Chicken Claw — cut, scratch, and slice your foes like the true cocky rooster you are, with a bleeding effect on top of that!
  • Chicken Wing — why did the chicken jump off the roof? Well, to soar through the skies with this new paraglider skin.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Chicken Bundle

dyinglight2-chickenbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Chicken Bundle

dyinglight2-soundtrack.description_text: Immerse into the world of Dying Light 2 Stay Human with the original music from the game.

dyinglight2stayhuman-welcomeoffer_essent.description_text:
Get started in Villedor with this essential welcome offer, featuring: the Kyle Crane appearance from The Beast, the legendary Kukri weapon, useful resources, and DLP for the in-game store.

DLC contains:

- Kukri Weapon

- Welcome Outfit

- 5x XP Boosters

- Welcome Resource Bundle

- 5000 Old World Money

- 1000 DL Points

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human - Welcome Offer: Essential Starter Kit

dyinglight2stayhuman-welcomeoffer_essent.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human - Welcome Offer: Essential Starter Kit

dyinglight2stayhuman_breckenbundle.description_text:
Run, boy, run! Become a strong leader that uses a full array of parkour moves as Brecken, a blast from the past. Run towards a danger, or run away from it when grabbing the loot. Whatever you do, do it for all survivors.

Test your skills in the Brecken Outfit, shock your enemies with the Voltaic Wrench and fly above the rooftops with Brecken’s Paraglider skin.

The bundle contains:
  • Brecken Outfit — lead the way and move swiftly as one of the first runners.
  • Voltaic Wrench  — shock your enemies by bashing their heads in.
  • Brecken’s Paraglider — when running is not enough, fly to your destination.

Become a leader that uses a full array of parkour moves with Brecken’s Bundle.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Brecken Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_breckenbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Brecken Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_dyinglaughbundle.description_text:
Some clowns have a sweet tooth for violence, and it looks like this one broke off from his circus group. He’s out for blood with an impending need to fulfill his most gruesome fantasies. Luckily for him, there are always enough monster skulls to go around in the City. Take on the identity of a silly yet unpredictable troublemaker to turn every punch into the perfect punchline.

Don a colorful, creepy killer clown mask and costume. Put on an unforgettable show for the unfortunate victims who will have to witness it firsthand. Turn those noses red by unleashing the Dying Laugh Weapon that produces waves of laughter with every hit you make. Additionally, take the Dying Laugh Paraglider to travel from venue to venue and catch involuntary guests by surprise. Let these handy items act as the perfect means to set up a gag that never gets old. After all, in a world where there’s a constant fight for survival, everyone could use a little cheering up.

The bundle contains:
  • Dying Laugh Weapon — bash foes with your side-splitting proficiency.
  • Dying Laugh — a horrifying costume like this is no joke.
  • Dying Laugh Paraglider — a unique paraglider skin. Let’s see who has the last laugh.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Dying Laugh Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_dyinglaughbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Dying Laugh Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_goodiespackarts.description_text:
This pack contains:
- Digital Artbook
- Digital Comic
- Wallpapers ready to print

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Goodies Pack-Arts

dyinglight2stayhuman_goodiespackarts.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Goodies Pack-Arts

dyinglight2stayhuman_grehazmatbundle.description_text:
These guys were responsible for keeping the virus contained. Just look at how that turned out. Now, don their outfit and use their equipment to show them what they should have done and take care of the situation in Villedor yourself!

Show the G.R.E. how to take care of the situation in Villedor!

It’s hard work, but someone’s got to go in and clean up the messes the G.R.E. leaves in their wake. But not you! Grab the G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle right now and add to the carnage left all over Villedor. Plus, the bundle comes with 500 DL Points to spend in the in-game store, too!*

Before and during the early days of the outbreak, these guys were taking care of the situation within the labs and quarantined buildings, but then all hell broke loose. Now it’s time to clean up The City, once and for all!

The G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle contains:

  • G.R.E. Hazmat Outfit

  • Hazmat Gear Items

  • Biohazard Pay SMG — The quickest way to clear out an area, and with each kill, your damage output increases until you reload!

  • Bonecutter Axe — Guns are fun and all, but sometimes you want to get up close and personal and really hack at your foes. With this axe, their limbs will come off so much easier! Good thing you're wearing a hazmat suit.

  • G.R.E. Token Charm — The G.R.E. were always looking for Infected Trophies, and with this charm, you’ll get some every time you dismantle it depending on how many zombies you’ve “taken care” of.

  • G.R.E. Grappling Hook — Zombie or not, if they’re trying to escape, you can’t let them get away.

  • Hazardous Paraglider — Seeing this in the sky will make any enemy start running away from your landing zone.

  • 500 DL Points — For you to spend in the in-game store!*

*Disclaimer: Due to Japanese laws and regulations, the 500 DL Points are not included in the G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle for purchases made within Japan.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_grehazmatbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: G.R.E. Hazmat Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_gunslingerbundle.description_text:
Celebrate the 10th Anniversary of Call of Juarez® Gunslinger with a special bundle that pays homage to the bounty hunter Silas Greaves.

It’s time to bring some of the old ways back to The City. Put on your cowboy hat, don the red poncho, roll up your sleeves, and duel with anyone who dares to look at you funny. Whether they’re undead or alive, your enemies won’t know what hit them as you drop dynamite, cut through them with your trusty knife, or better yet, drop from the sky using the new paraglider. Whatever you do, show ‘em all why true gunslingers say that if you climb in the saddle, you’d better be ready for the ride.

This bundle contains:
  • Silas Greaves Outfit – vengeance will lead the way on this one, with the stench of death not far behind.
  • The Gunslinger – leave your horse at the stables. Travel with a paraglider that bears an image of the famous bounty hunter instead.
  • Bowie Knife – even a cowboy needs one for the road. You never know when you’ll run out of bullets.
  • Bowie Knife Blueprint – the key to building and upgrading your weapon. Sharper, stronger, and to the point.
  • Dynamite Blueprint – mine through walls of Infected. Go wild with a throwable that is bound to send shockwaves.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Gunslinger Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_gunslingerbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Gunslinger Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_hakonbundle.description_text:
Become the fierce nightrunner hellbent on survival with the new Hakon Bundle. Arm yourself with charm, wit, and the tools necessary to navigate through the treacherous nights of The City.
Channel Hakon’s signature style (and charm) then pop some Infected heads with his trademark bow. And if you wanna be a real hot shot, add a fire bolt; that way things will really start heating up. But don’t worry if you can’t handle the heat (or you run into an old flame), Hakon’s paraglider will make sure you can make a quick getaway!

This bundle contains:
  • Hakon’s Appearance — do whatever you need to survive, and look good while doing it.
  • Hakon's Crossbow — aim steady, and let them take an arrow to the knee... or the head.
  • Regular Bolts & Fire Bolts — become a proper firestarter with these special bolts. Just don’t forget to reload.
  • Hakon’s Paraglider — this paraglider may help you flee from a horde of Infected or… a romantic exploit gone bad.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Hakon Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_hakonbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Hakon Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_nightrunnerbundle.description_text:
Buy the new Nightrunner Bundle. Show no mercy to your enemies by mutilating them in combat, whether you help survivors during the day or brave the dangers of the night.

This bundle contains:
  • Nightrunner Outfit — wear it when the days are hot and bloody.
  • Cutting Edge Axe — a limb here, a limb there…dismember your foes with ease and let the blood run like water.
  • Nightrunner Coat — will help you keep your cool in a sweaty situation.
  • Nightrunner Trousers — stay comfortable as you creep around.
  • Nightrunner Trainers — silently tread past the dangers of the night.
  • Nightrunner Gloves — insulating your hands without losing on maneuverability.
  • Nightrunner Mask — better safe than sorry. You never know who could be watching from the shadows.
  • Nightrunner Guards — keep the monsters from chomping on you. Your forearms, at least.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Nightrunner Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_nightrunnerbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Nightrunner Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_post-apobundle.description_text:
Buy the new Post-Apo Bundle before the world collapses yet again! It’s been 15 years since the fall, but that doesn’t seem to stop you, not in the least! Make sure to keep that survivor spirit when scavenging for supplies and fighting off surprising dangers such a brutal world offers.

This bundle contains:
  • Scrapper Outfit — no one said that a rugged outfit can’t be smart, resourceful, flexible, and resistant. Be prepared for any extreme scenario.
  • Rough Duster — at least the dust is on the outside.
  • Bleak Pants — nothing special, but they get the job done.
  • Well-Worn Boots — just as busted up as the skulls you smash every day.
  • Tattered Leather Gauntlets — more dried-up blood than leather, aren't they?
  • Dystopian Mask — works both as protection and a deterrent.
  • Spiked Bracers — offense is the best defense.
  • Scrap Slicer — if the cut doesn't kill them, the rust will.
  • Patchy Paraglider — it may be a makeshift solution, but it gets the job done.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Post-apo Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_post-apobundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Post-apo Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_rahimbundle.description_text:
Imagine what life would’ve been like for Rahim outside of Harran. Scavenge the streets of Villedor as the gloating runner or take on the lifeless form of his special Infected variant outfit. Make sure to keep your cool as you fend off hordes with the Pickaxe, modified to deal fiery damage, and take to the skies like a pro with a new paraglider that glows in the dark.
It’s time for the original runners to show Nightrunners how it’s really done.

This bundle contains:
  • Rahim Outfit - "Y'know why runners put their lives in danger? For guys like you"
  • Pickaxe - once used by miners to break rocks, now used to break Infected.
  • Rahim's Paraglider - if Rahim saw you flying with this, he'd say, "Not bad...For a noob!"
  • Viral Rahim Outfit - "Try not to slow down once you start running. Out there, if you stop — you're probably dead"

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Rahim Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_rahimbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Rahim Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_raisbundle.description_text:
It’s time to live by your own rules and become the most feared man in The City. Satisfy your hunger for power and wealth as Rais, a powerful warlord who strikes fear in the hearts of all survivors.

Don the Rais’ Outfit, take pleasure in slicing your enemies (both human and Infected) with the Wolfclaw machete, and use the Rais’ Paraglider skin to reside high above anyone else as only the true ruler should.

The bundle contains:
  • Rais Outfit —  dress as the original cold-blooded villain
  • Wolfclaw  — be ruthless to your enemies and cut them up however you like with this sharp machete.
  • Rais’ Paraglider  — soar through the sky and bring justice from above.

It’s time to live by your own rules with Rais’ Bundle.

front_page_art.image_text: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Rais Bundle

dyinglight2stayhuman_raisbundle.human_name: Dying Light 2 Stay Human: Rais Bundle
